notes.title: Update 1.1.0 : Breakable Windows
notes.content: -Added Dirty breakable windows. You can also crouch jump through them if they are already cracked, completely shattering them.

tags.feature: -Added Dirty breakable windows. You can also crouch jump through them if they are already cracked, completely shattering them.

notes.title: Update 1.0.9 : Physics fixes and improvements
notes.content:
-It is now possible to crouch-jump through windows.
-Fixed many physics bounding volumes.
-Increased static objects physics volume detail so they can handle small object better.
-Debris/Gibs no longer collide with Doors to avoid blocking them.

tags.feature: -It is now possible to crouch-jump through windows.

tags.balance_change: -Increased static objects physics volume detail so they can handle small object better.

tags.bug: -Debris/Gibs no longer collide with Doors to avoid blocking them.

notes.title: Update v1.0.8 : New Gore Level available: Excessive
notes.content:
-New Gameplay Option: Gore Level: Excessive. (Note that existing player will need to increase this manually)
-New Gameplay Option: Dismemberment Chance Multiplier 0-200%.
-Town Cleared Statistics can now be toggled on/off. (Same key as normal statistics toggle)
-Some Ragdoll fixes and tweaks. Ragdoll Hat and Weapon can be shot.
-Tweaked Limb Damage Multiplier values a bit.
-Fixed Outlaw could get stuck in reload animation when trying to reload before completely out of bullets.

tags.feature: -New Gameplay Option: Gore Level: Excessive. (Note that existing player will need to increase this manually)
- Town Cleared Statistics can now be toggled on/off. (Same key as normal statistics toggle)

tags.bug: -Some Ragdoll fixes and tweaks. Ragdoll Hat and Weapon can be shot.

tags.balance_change: -Tweaked Limb Damage Multiplier values a bit.

tags.bug: -Fixed Outlaw could get stuck in reload animation when trying to reload before completely out of bullets.

notes.title: Update 1.0.7 : Projectile Penetration
notes.content:
-Added Projectile Penetration along with a 0-200% Gameplay option.
-Updated most 3d models to have separated material volumes.
-Added more material types with their own hit sounds and visual effects.

tags.feature: -Added Projectile Penetration along with a 0-200% Gameplay option.
-Added more material types with their own hit sounds and visual effects.
